# RoyalGambit Chess

> A modern, open-source chess learning and playing platform built with Next.js, Tauri, and Supabase.

Production URL: https://royal-gambit-chess.vercel.app

## Project Overview

RoyalGambit is a full-stack chess platform providing:
- Interactive lessons and tutorials for all skill levels
- Multiplayer chess gameplay (PvP and vs Bot)
- Game analysis and replay with Stockfish engine
- ELO-based rating system and leaderboards
- Desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux

## Tech Stack

### Frontend
- Framework: Next.js 16+ (App Router, TypeScript)
- UI: React 19, TailwindCSS 4, shadcn/ui, Radix UI
- Animation: Framer Motion
- Chess Board: react-chessboard + chess.js
- State: Zustand (client), TanStack React Query (server)

### Backend
- Backend as a Service: Supabase (Auth, PostgreSQL, Realtime, Storage)
- API: Next.js API Routes (server-side)
- Chess Engine: Stockfish.js (WASM, runs in WebWorker)

### Desktop App
- Framework: Tauri 2.x (Rust-based native wrapper)
- Targets: Windows (MSI), macOS (DMG, arm64/x64), Linux (AppImage, DEB)

### Testing
- Unit/Integration: Vitest
- E2E: Playwright with axe-core accessibility testing
- Security: RLS policy validation tests

### Deployment
- Web: Vercel
- Desktop: GitHub Releases via GitHub Actions

## Project Structure

```
chess/
├── src/
│   ├── app/                      # Next.js App Router pages
│   │   ├── api/                  # API routes
│   │   │   ├── games/           # Game CRUD, moves, join
│   │   │   ├── learn/           # Learning system API
│   │   │   ├── matchmaking/     # Queue management
│   │   │   ├── ratings/         # ELO calculations
│   │   │   ├── leaderboard/     # Rankings
│   │   │   ├── invitations/     # Game invites
│   │   │   ├── game-review/     # Analysis queue
│   │   │   └── rtc/             # WebRTC signaling
│   │   ├── game/[id]/           # Live game room
│   │   ├── game/[id]/review/    # Game analysis view
│   │   ├── play/                # Game mode selection
│   │   ├── bot/                 # Play vs Stockfish
│   │   ├── learn/               # Learning hub & lessons
│   │   ├── leaderboard/         # ELO rankings
│   │   ├── profile/[username]/  # User profiles
│   │   ├── archive/             # Game history
│   │   └── settings/            # User settings
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── chess/               # ChessBoard, Clock, MoveList, etc.
│   │   ├── review/              # EvaluationBar, AccuracyChart
│   │   ├── learn/               # LessonBoard, QuizCard, TrackCard
│   │   ├── layout/              # Navbar, Footer
│   │   ├── ui/                  # shadcn/ui components
│   │   └── providers/           # React context providers
│   ├── hooks/                   # useAuth, useGameReview, useStockfish
│   ├── lib/
│   │   ├── supabase/            # Client, server, middleware, admin
│   │   ├── stockfish/           # Chess engine integration
│   │   ├── api/                 # API utilities
│   │   └── config.ts            # Site configuration
│   ├── stores/                  # Zustand: gameStore, authStore, learnStore
│   └── types/                   # TypeScript type definitions
├── supabase/
│   ├── migrations/              # Database migrations
│   └── seed.sql                 # Initial data
├── src-tauri/                   # Desktop app (Rust/Tauri)
├── tests/
│   ├── unit/                    # Unit tests
│   ├── integration/             # Integration tests
│   ├── e2e/                     # Playwright E2E tests
│   └── security/                # RLS security tests
├── requirements/                # Feature specifications (JSON)
└── public/                      # Static assets
```

## Key Features

### Game Modes
- Play vs Bot: Stockfish AI with 5 difficulty levels
- Play vs Friend: PvP with shareable game codes
- Matchmaking: Automatic opponent pairing with queue system
- Spectating: Watch ongoing games in real-time

### Time Controls
- Bullet: 1+0, 2+1
- Blitz: 3+0, 3+2, 5+0, 5+3
- Rapid: 10+0, 10+5, 15+10
- Classical: 30+0

### Learning System
- Learning Tracks: Chess Basics, Opening Principles, Essential Endgames, Strategic Thinking
- Interactive Lessons: Step-by-step guidance with board interaction
- Step Types: explain, move_task, quiz, puzzle
- Progress Tracking: Completion status, streaks, achievements

### Game Analysis
- Move Classification: best, good, inaccuracy, mistake, blunder
- Accuracy Metrics: ACPL (Average Centipawn Loss)
- Evaluation Bar: Visual position assessment
- Move Timeline: Navigate through game with analysis

### User System
- Authentication: Supabase Auth (email/password)
- Profiles: Username, avatar, bio, country, privacy settings
- ELO Ratings: Per time control with history tracking
- Leaderboards: Global rankings by rating

## Database Schema (Key Tables)

- **profiles**: User profiles (username, display_name, avatar_url, bio, country_code)
- **games**: Game records (mode, players, fen, pgn, status, result, time_control)
- **moves**: Individual moves (game_id, ply, uci, san, fen_after)
- **ratings**: ELO per user per time control (elo, games_played, wins/losses/draws)
- **rating_history**: Append-only audit trail for ELO changes
- **matchmaking_queue**: Real-time matchmaking (user_id, time_control)
- **invitations**: Friend game invites (from_user_id, to_user_id, status)
- **learn_tracks**: Learning tracks (slug, title, level, description)
- **learn_lessons**: Lessons within tracks (slug, title, topic, steps)
- **learn_steps**: Lesson steps (type, content, fen, move tasks)
- **learn_progress**: User lesson completion tracking

## API Endpoints

### Games
- POST /api/games/create - Create new game
- GET /api/games/get - Fetch game details
- POST /api/games/join - Join waiting game
- POST /api/games/move - Submit move (server-validated)
- POST /api/games/[id]/finish - Finalize game
- POST /api/games/[id]/resign - Player resignation

### Learning
- GET /api/learn/tracks - All learning tracks
- GET /api/learn/lessons/[slug] - Lesson content
- POST /api/learn/progress/lesson - Record lesson completion
- GET /api/learn/recommended - Suggested content

### Social
- POST /api/matchmaking/enqueue - Join matchmaking queue
- GET /api/leaderboard - ELO rankings
- GET /api/invitations - Received invitations

### Analysis
- POST /api/game-review/queue - Submit for analysis
- GET /api/game-review/status/[id] - Analysis progress

## Key Patterns

### Move Validation Flow
1. Client sends UCI move to /api/games/move
2. Server reconstructs game from initial_fen + moves table
3. Server validates move legality using chess.js
4. If valid: insert move, update current_fen, broadcast realtime event
5. Client updates local state from response

### Real-time Synchronization
- Supabase Realtime subscriptions on games, moves, matchmaking_queue, invitations tables
- Presence tracking for online status
- Optimistic UI updates with server reconciliation

### Security
- Row-Level Security (RLS) on all tables
- Server-side move validation (anti-cheat)
- JWT authentication via Supabase
- No service role keys in client bundles

## Development

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 20+
- pnpm
- Supabase CLI (for local development)
- Rust (for desktop builds)

### Environment Variables
- NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
- NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
- SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (server-only)
- NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL

### Commands
- `pnpm dev` - Start development server
- `pnpm build` - Build for production
- `pnpm test` - Run unit tests
- `pnpm test:e2e` - Run E2E tests
- `pnpm tauri dev` - Start desktop development
- `pnpm tauri build` - Build desktop app

## Requirements Documentation

Detailed feature specifications are in the `/requirements` folder:
- requirements.json - Core platform specification
- learning.json - Learning system expansion
- game-review.json - Game analysis system
- desktop-app.json - Desktop application requirements
- seo.json - SEO and content requirements
- testing-requirements.json - Testing specifications
